Through: Mr. Satish Kumar,
 with S.I.Manoj K
 Sarao Rohilla.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma
 Or
% 12.01.2024
1.

The instant petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Cr.P.C.) has been instituted on behalf of the petitioners seeking quashing of FIR bearing No. 1264/2014,
registered at Police Station Sarai Rohilla, Delhi, for offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC).
2.
Learned APP appearing on behalf of the State accepts notice.

3. Issue notice to the complainant, through the Investigating Officer concerned, returnable on 26.04.2024.
4.
The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
